name: Great Barrier Reef
about: Dry season (May–Oct) has the best visibility and — importantly — no dangerous stinger jellyfish in open water. Wet season (Nov–Apr) requires stinger suits to swim.
overview: The world's largest coral reef system, explored by day-boat from Cairns or overnight from a handful of private island resorts.
costOverview: Everyday food and coffee are typical Australian prices — the real cost is the reef trip itself, and quality varies a lot by price tier.

specialSeasons.text: Dangerous stinger jellyfish are present in the water — swimming requires a protective stinger suit.
